decisions.decision: Keep state, actions, and typed parts as the public controller facade over one private owned behavior and effect runtime.
React 18.3 and 19, Svelte 5, and current Solid 1.x are equal stable framework targets.
Vue and Angular are removed completely without compatibility shims; historical conduct artifacts remain immutable.
The stable catalog contains the 61 primitives named in the source specification plus its shared collections and utilities.
Package installation and copied-source installation are equally supported outputs of one canonical definition pipeline.
Patterns and sf are separately versioned experimental products and cannot block or be dependencies of the stable 1.0 release.
WCAG 2.2 AA, applicable APG and native behavior, explicit browser interaction evidence, VoiceOver, NVDA, and TalkBack are mandatory; JAWS alone is user-deferred and disclosed as untested.
Hard package size, runtime latency, long-task, virtualization, and leak budgets are release blocking.
Signed manual evidence, unresolved-defect review, dependency, license and provenance review, and independent accessibility review are mandatory before 1.0.
No item outside the explicit JAWS and experimental-product boundaries may be downgraded to MVP, optional, partial, preview, or post-1.0 without a new user decision.
